say:1:1711064001:1.text: Magister Merlin, Envoy Evie, come take a look at this!
say:1:1711064001:1.source_cn: 梅林大人，伊芙大人，你们快来看看这个！
say:1:1711064001:1.male: Magister Merlin, Envoy Evie, come take a look at this!
say:1:1711064001:1.female: Magister Merlin, Envoy Evie, come take a look at this!

say:2:1711064002:1.text: I found these potions. After analyzing, they appear to be a variant of high-level mind control potions.
say:2:1711064002:1.source_cn: 我找到了这些药剂。经过简单的成分解析，这是高阶精神控制...

say:3:1711064003:1.text: And there's also this "Discarded Specimen Report". It details the disposal of a body that died after forced mana extraction.
say:3:1711064003:1.source_cn: 还有这份《废弃样本处理报告》，上面的记录显示此处曾处理...

say:4:1711064004:1.source_cn: 而那个受害者的名字——是埃摩森。

say:6:1711064005:1.text: Emerson was the same court mage who supposedly died in an accident a while back.
say:6:1711064005:1.source_cn: 如果我没猜错的话，这个埃摩森就是之前意外去世的宫廷魔法师。

say:7:1711064006:1.text: Back then, the Arcane Affairs Office stated he died during an experiment gone wrong. But that's clearly not the truth.
say:7:1711064006:1.source_cn: 当时，魔法事务司通报说，魔法师埃摩森因实验意外而身亡。...

say:8:1711064007:1.text: Emerson's "accident" perfectly matches the records and research you found. The truth is undeniable.
say:8:1711064007:1.source_cn: 埃摩森的事故与你发现的论文和记录完全对应，真相已经昭然...
say:8:1711064007:1.male: Emerson's "accident" perfectly matches the records and research you found. The truth is undeniable.
say:8:1711064007:1.female: Emerson's "accident" perfectly matches the records and research you found. The truth is undeniable.

say:9:1711064008:1.text: He didn't die in an accident. Cyran used him as a human test subject to verify the forbidden art, "Dark Extraction".
say:9:1711064008:1.source_cn: 埃摩森并不是死于意外，他是被迪尔格雷当成了小白鼠，用来...

say:10:1711064009:1.text: With Emerson gone, a court mage position opened up. That meant a selection had to be held.
say:10:1711064009:1.source_cn: 除掉了埃摩森，宫廷魔法师的位置就空了出来。这样一来，就...

say:11:1711064010:1.text: Through all this, Cyran not only completed his forbidden experiment, but also cleared the path to secure Gervan's place in the court.
say:11:1711064010:1.source_cn: 迪尔格雷通过此事，既完成了禁术实验，又顺势铺平了道路，...

say:12:1711064011:1.text: Everyone's eyes drift toward Gervan. He keeps his head down, offering no denial. Clearly, he was part of this scheme.
say:12:1711064011:1.source_cn: 众人下意识地看向角落里的格墨文。他低着头，并没有反驳，...

say:13:1711064012:1.text: But you know better. While he played his part, when it came to the most critical moment, he made a choice of his own.
say:13:1711064012:1.source_cn: 但你很清楚，虽然他接受了安排，但在那件最关键的事情上，...
say:13:1711064012:1.male: But you know better. While he played his part, when it came to the most critical moment, he made a choice of his own.
say:13:1711064012:1.female: But you know better. While he played his part, when it came to the most critical moment, he made a choice of his own.

choice_prompt:14:1711064012.text: But you know better. While he played his part, when it came to the most critical moment, he made a choice of his own.
choice_prompt:14:1711064012.source_cn: 但你很清楚，虽然他接受了安排，但在那件最关键的事情上，他做出了唯一的选择。
choice_prompt:14:1711064012.male: But you know better. While he played his part, when it came to the most critical moment, he made a choice of his own.
choice_prompt:14:1711064012.female: But you know better. While he played his part, when it came to the most critical moment, he made a choice of his own.

say:16:1711064013:1.text: Enough! Why do you insist on bringing up that pointless, failed plan?
say:16:1711064013:1.source_cn: 多此一举！你一定要说出这种没用的废案吗？
say:16:1711064013:1.male: Enough! Why do you insist on bringing up that pointless, failed plan?
say:16:1711064013:1.female: Enough! Why do you insist on bringing up that pointless, failed plan?

say:19:1711064015:1.text: Don't look at me like that. I just didn't want to owe you anything.
say:19:1711064015:1.source_cn: 别自作多情了，我只是单纯地不想欠你的人情。

say:20:1711064016:1.text: Besides... Who in their right mind would willingly accept a curse like that?
say:20:1711064016:1.source_cn: 而且……像这种百害无一利的要求，你也不可能甘愿接受。

say:21:1711064017:1.text: How do you know I wouldn't? If it were for you... I might have actually done it.
say:21:1711064017:1.source_cn: 你怎么知道我不愿意？如果是为了你……或许我真的愿意呢？

say:24:1711064020:1.text: You glance at the two of them standing there in silence, and turn the group's attention back to the ritual circle.
say:24:1711064020:1.source_cn: 你看了一眼陷入沉默的两人，并没有多言，而是转言说起了密...
say:24:1711064020:1.male: You glance at the two of them standing there in silence, and turn the group's attention back to the ritual circle.
say:24:1711064020:1.female: You glance at the two of them standing there in silence, and turn the group's attention back to the ritual circle.

say:26:1711064021:1.text: Is there something we missed about this circle?
say:26:1711064021:1.source_cn: 梅林大人？这个法阵，有什么问题吗？
say:26:1711064021:1.male: Is there something we missed about this circle?
say:26:1711064021:1.female: Is there something we missed about this circle?

say:27:1711064022:1.text: You explain Cyran's research into forbidden magic and his ultimate goal. It feels strangely familiar...
say:27:1711064022:1.source_cn: 你讲述了迪尔格雷对禁术的研究和终极目标，那个目标看起来...
say:27:1711064022:1.male: You explain Cyran's research into forbidden magic and his ultimate goal. It feels strangely familiar...
say:27:1711064022:1.female: You explain Cyran's research into forbidden magic and his ultimate goal. It feels strangely familiar...

say:28:1711064023:1.text: But first, you need to investigate properly.
say:28:1711064023:1.source_cn: 不过，一切得先调查看看。
say:28:1711064023:1.male: But first, you need to investigate properly.
say:28:1711064023:1.female: But first, you need to investigate properly.

choice:14:0:1.source_cn: （你讲述了格墨文腿伤恢复的真相）
